(()=>{const results=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry[data-tool=web_search]')];if(!results.some(e=>!e.dataset.failed&&!e.innerText.includes('Running web_search')))throw Error('Successful MCP web_search receipt missing');const links=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-sources a')];if(!links.length)throw Error('Source links missing');const last=[...document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-assistant')].at(-1);last?.scrollIntoView({block:'center'});return {successfulSearchReceipts:results.filter(e=>!e.dataset.failed&&!e.innerText.includes('Running web_search')).length,sourceLinks:links.map(a=>({title:a.textContent,url:a.href})),assistantReplies:document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-entry.is-assistant').length,errors:document.querySelectorAll('.assistant-chat-error').length}})()
